reliability.rationale: Coarse inverse-area scaling beats the constant on held dies, but one die accounts for a large error and an extreme development device is retained. Failure of richer hypotheses is informative.

mechanism.rationale: Nominal-area conductance is physically plausible and established; response-channel gain and measured dimensions are absent, so intrinsic junction resistance and edge physics are not identified.

novelty.rationale: Targeted source-paper review is disclosed. These known model families and local extensions do not establish literature priority or a new fundamental law.

significance.rationale: A reproducible screening baseline with explicit device counterexamples; accuracy is insufficient for universal yield or fabrication optimization.

reproducibility.rationale: Exact states, native anchors and held-group results are present; independent computational replay is a separate review.

impact.rationale: No industrial deployment, intervention, measurement-cost experiment or external replication is included.

checks: Inspected all group results and baseline comparisons
Checked explicit calibration, target meaning and interpretation limits
limitations: Only two wafers; five held dies; response gain undocumented; no process intervention.
